# Escape Holes

Smallest drain hole of a hollow; also warns of a hollow with only one.

<figure markdown="span">
![Escape Holes: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-escape-hole-diameter-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Escape Holes: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-escape-hole-diameter-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Diameter of the holes a hollow drains through, ideally two on opposite sides.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | High |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | High |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 3.5 mm | 2.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 2: 3.5 mm drain holes")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Form 3: 2.5 mm drain holes") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 5 mm | 3.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "5 mm")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "At least 3.5 mm"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls) |
    | TPU | 10 mm | 10 mm | Published, [Materialise](../../citations/bibliography.md#materialise-tpu "At least two escape holes of 10 mm") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Small drain holes (`{measured}`): `{feature}` drains through `{holes}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Resin drains slowly through small holes and some stays inside. Make the holes bigger.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Drain holes too small (`{measured}`): `{feature}` drains through `{holes}`, under `{limit}`. Resin will stay trapped inside and can crack the part or blow out the hollow. Make the drain holes at least `{target}` across.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Small escape holes (`{measured}`): `{feature}` empties through `{holes}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Powder is slow to blast out of small holes and some stays inside. Make the holes bigger.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Escape holes too small (`{measured}`): `{feature}` empties through `{holes}`, under `{limit}`. Powder will stay packed inside. Make the escape holes at least `{target}` across.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{holes}` | How many escape holes and the smallest, such as "2 escape holes, the smallest Ø3.00 mm" |
